_note: Lines posted with calls, flips and retractions. flavor.py picks them: a line isn't used again until every other line in its pool has had a turn. Pools: call, hold (the seat stays put), flip (it changes hands), upset (the ratings favored someone else), control (a chamber), retract, desk_ahead, desk_behind, desk_wrong. A line can name {winner}, {loser}, {place}, {seat}, {rating} and {party}; the desk_ lines can use {outlet} and {lead}. Edit freely; changes apply without restarting.

An optional "retract" list is used instead of the generic retract line when that race's call is withdrawn. Each references a real 2026 campaign moment (see the meme file). Add, edit or delete freely; changes apply live.
